historical_source.title: Selected Topics in Random Walk in Random Environment
historical_source.locator: Open question 2.20, PDF page 24 (zero-based 23), printed page 22; definitions 2.13-2.14 on printed page 18
historical_source.historical_conclusion: Almost-sure positive liminf of projected speed; deterministic velocity is a standard equivalent consequence in this iid UE setting.

exact_target: For every d>=2, every iid law of nearest-neighbour site transition kernels on Z^d with deterministic uniform lower bound kappa>0 on all 2d transitions, and every fixed unit vector ell: if the annealed law from 0 satisfies X_n dot ell -> +infinity almost surely, then X_n/n -> a deterministic vector v with v dot ell>0 almost surely.

prior_attempts.gap: Transience yields finite regeneration times almost surely, but not their finite expectation.
prior_attempts.assessment: The regeneration-integrability obstruction is retained; heuristic trap-density statements are not adopted as proofs.

comparator_assumptions: probability measure nu on nearest-neighbour rows
recent_resolution_claim.verdict: The linked comparator is an admitted statement, not a formal proof receipt. Its placeholder does not invalidate a separate paper or proof artifact.
recent_resolution_claim.actual_proof_artifact_checked: 32-line entrypoint only, delegates to directional_transience_implies_ballisticity_unit; transitive proof not checked

kalikow_external_dependency.theorem: Kalikow's uniform positive finite-domain drift criterion implies ballisticity for iid UE nearest-neighbour RWRE, with deterministic limiting velocity
kalikow_external_dependency.original_reference: Sznitman-Zerner (1999), A law of large numbers for random walks in random environment
kalikow_external_dependency.proof_here: not re-proved; used as an explicit standard dependency

novelty: No novelty or parent-target resolution claim.

recall.lesson: A pipeline/source/formal statement check is not proof of the hardest mathematical gap.
